inputs.text: [serious] It was a carnivore. It hunted big plant-eaters, [confident] maybe in a hunting team rather than alone.
[hesitant] Scientists aren't sure, [gently] but it's possible: several raptors together could take down prey much bigger than themselves.
[confident] In its land, at its time, [warmly] nothing big enough has ever been found. It was the top hunter.
